name: bypass-permissions-dialog
opens_with: (--bypass-permissions on `simulate`, mirroring the real CLI flag)
notes: Red-bordered risk warning with an explicit accept/decline choice. The default selection is index 0 (decline), so assert_screen pins BOTH option strings to catch a default flip. This is the cheapest unblock in the corpus — one boolean at an existing parameter. Reachable since `simulate` grew a --bypass-permissions flag that is threaded into the existing TuiApp::enter parameter. It has to be a flag and not an agent-script event: the dialog is raised in TuiApp::enter, before any key or event is processed.
